We are committed to growing with our partners by providing the best matting solution, highest quality and the fastest delivery to the end-user customer. This commitment is the reason why we are by far the #1 Mat Company in the Indian Sub-Continent.

Backed with a strong national network and a large reseller base internationally, our diversified operations are seamlessly integrated right from product manufacturing to organized retail to providing high quality end-customer service.

Our high business ethics, reliability of our products and services and respect for people have contributed towards building our good corporate image in the industry.

Corporate Resellers

We are a market leader in the matting industry worldwide, and our brands are well-recognized and highly successful for functionality, lasting performance and aesthetics.

With our Company's vision of playing an instrumental role in promoting a clean and dust-free environment, we are looking for Business Partners in your city for Corporate Sales.

What can I sell?

As an Ultimats Corporate Reseller, you will have preferred access to our full range of customized matting products for sale to corporates and institutions.

How can I make money?

You will receive commission for every mat you sell. Your commissions increase as your total sales increase. For every confirmed order, Ultimats will custom-manufacture the mats, invoice and dispatch the same to you or your corporate customer. So you do not need to invest in stocks, maintain a warehouse, or carry any delivery hassles. And should you prefer Ultimats to directly invoice the customer, you are also relieved from registering yourself with the GST Authorities.

Simple, isn't it? Just meet our eligibility criteria, book orders and start earning money from today itself.

Who should join the program?

Marketing firms, interior designers, project consultants, vendors to corporates and institutions, freelance mat sellers, housekeeping firms, dynamic individuals or any firm that provides complementary products and services.

If you have the solutions and reseller experience to deliver true customer value marketing information, the Ultimats Corporate Reseller Programme may just be right for you.
